attempts.exactPrompt:
Create exactly one full-body Summonlab combat chibi derived only from the supplied verified summon portrait. Canvas 1024 x 1536. Keep the character an adult and unmistakably the exact same person; simplify shapes for a clean painterly combat-game chibi. PROPORTION LOCK: the complete head-and-hair unit occupies 32 to 36 percent of the standing figure height, producing 2.75 to 3.1 heads total. Use a clearly oversized adult head, compact torso, and shortened legs; never render a 3.5-head, 4-head, or tall-miniature figure. Preserve relative body widths without generic inflation of the body. Use a grounded ready-idle three-quarter pose, both empty hands and both feet completely visible, with a generous safe margin and a warm pale parchment studio wash.

Identity continuity: Ulo Eshor, age 34, gender presentation woman, skin-value band 3; heart-shaped face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; no added facial mark Preserve adult age cues, face geometry, skin, and expression; use a calm closed mouth with no smile or theatrical acting. Enlarge the cranium for chibi scale without replacing the source eye shape, eye spacing, brow structure, nose, mouth, jaw, or cheek planes with a shared generic doll-face template; the roster must retain visibly different adult faces at combat scale. Body continuity: athletic-conditioned, medium; 176 cm; conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition. Preserve shoulder and torso width, mass, softness, muscle distribution, upper-arm and forearm girth, wrist scale, hand size, leg mass, and posture. Do not make the arms, hands, shoulders, torso, or body fatter or bulkier merely because this is chibi. Tall or slight identity must read through shape and posture without shrinking the head below the required chibi ratio.

Hair continuity: dark-brown asymmetric-extreme; accent: none. Preserve the front and side silhouette of asymmetric-extreme, the parting, gathered mass, shaved areas, and none; color remains dark-brown. Wardrobe continuity: asymmetric-patchwork in rust-charcoal; intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges. Condition: deliberately tousled but clean. Preserve every visible seam, repair, closure, accessory, tattoo, marking, and palette relationship that survives at chibi scale. Personal anchors: a narrow bracelet stack; two plain rings; a carved belt buckle. Add nothing new.

The sole reference is the exact candidate authorized by summon target ulo-eshor-summon-v1 and verified result result-ulo-eshor-summon-v1 at assets/heroes/experiments/one-star-overnight-200-001/waves/wave-02/results/ulo-eshor/summon-v1.json; these identifiers are provenance only and must not appear in the image. No other identity, anatomy, wardrobe, or style reference is authorized. No weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, label, logo, watermark, extra person, duplicate anatomy, cropped extremity, baby proportions, photographic finish, plastic 3D, or published-character resemblance.

findings.observation: The chibi retains Ulo’s light-medium skin, heart-shaped full-cheeked face, sharply defined brows, long straight nose, narrow closed mouth, and calm adult identity.
Her conditioned athletic construction remains functional and toned without ripped definition or a bulky torso; the medium-height language survives the compact pose.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and hands remain coherent with the source’s athletic proportions and do not show the generic heavy-arm inflation seen in rejected calibration chibis.
The dark-brown asymmetric swept mass is recognizable, but the source’s closely shaved side was changed into multiple new braids, violating exact shaved-area continuity and the add-nothing-new rule.
Rust-charcoal asymmetric patchwork, uneven repaired hems, practical trousers, contrasting inner edges, narrow bracelet stack, two rings, and carved buckle remain clearly recognizable.

Measured visually from top hair to chin against top hair to grounded feet, the head-and-hair unit is approximately 27–28% of standing height, about 3.6 heads tall, outside the required 32–36% / 2.75–3.1 range.
Exactly one complete figure is shown with the full head, hair, both hands, both feet, clothing, and accessories inside generous margins.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle stance, empty hands, asymmetric hair, and broad patchwork silhouette remain readable at combat-icon scale.
No weapon, armor upgrade, attack, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark appears.

attempts.retryReason: Requires a new versioned correction target: enlarge the complete head-and-hair unit into the locked 32–36% range and restore the source shaved side without added braids while preserving all passing traits.
